title: idempotency/wrap.go
description: Wrap keeps 'The key row is inserted first and completed in the same transaction', 'A duplicate in progress gets 409, a changed body 422, and a match a replay' and 'A transient failure stores nothing': it takes a transaction-scoped advisory lock with no wait on a hash of the tenant, the principal and the key mixed with the OID of the key table, inserts the key row with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING in the caller's transaction, runs the handler, and completes the row in the same transaction; otherwise it reads the row FOR UPDATE NOWAIT and answers 409, 422 or a replay. The headers are stored in a length-prefixed binary form, so every byte comes back. A lock failure, SQLSTATE 55P03 or a cancel in a statement of Wrap is 409, and any other database error is a StatementError that hides its SQLSTATE (ST-SUP-RP10-LC25). Tx (with Rollback, so only a transaction fits) and Row are the consumer-side interfaces, SQLTx adapts a *sql.Tx, and Wrap expects READ COMMITTED. KeyFrom reads the Idempotency-Key header as an RFC 9651 structured string and gives ErrKeyMissing or ErrKeyMalformed for the 400.

Hold keeps 'A holder that cannot renew stops before the lease expires' and stops on the fenced error. Release makes the lease expire.

Flush writes the last checkpoint again at shutdown, before the lease is released.
